scope: Proposition 6.1 of the manuscript “A counterexample to the Monge ansatz for the three-marginal Coulomb cost” (preprints/A-counterexample-to-the-Monge-ansatz-for-the-three-marginal-Coulomb-cost-September-25-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 373 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 46caabb465529133), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 9. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For the probability measure µ of Theorem 1.1, inf T2,T3:R3→R3 Borel (T2)#µ=(T3)#µ=µ Z c(x, T2(x), T3(x)) dµ(x) = E∗(µ). Every pair in this infimum has cost strictly greater than the common infimum, but pairs with finite cost approach it.
